items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by exchange flow
items.detail: The composite sits at the 36th percentile, but the exchange flow axis is at 75 while the rest average 40 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except exchange flow, which reads 75/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-4.8% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 8.03M SPX. 4w -1.4% · 12w -4.8% · 26w -10.5%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-4.8% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: 1 new proven top-timer in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 1 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.
items.checkable: First crossing of the ROI+capital bar per wallet, from the sale history.

items.headline: The base is sitting tighter than usual
items.detail: Liveliness 0.607 is 1.4σ down vs its month. Rising = old coins moving (distribution/rotation); falling = holders sitting still (accumulation).
items.framing: Coins are sitting tighter — liveliness fell. The base is holding, dormancy deepening.
items.checkable: Coin-days-destroyed vs coin-days-stored from the FIFO reconstruction.

items.detail: Top-100 share is 57.5% of holder supply, 1.8σ down vs its month.
items.framing: The largest 100 wallets gave up share this month (57.5%, 1.8σ). Broadening holder base — decentralising.
items.checkable: Top-100 addresses' share of tracked supply, from the transfer history.

items.headline: 1.72M SPX left in a day
items.detail: 2026-08-25: 83 wallets dropped below the 5k bar with 1.72M SPX, 4.1σ above the usual churn — 76% in profit (profit-taking).
items.framing: A profit-taking exit wave — 83 wallets banked 1.72M SPX and stepped down. Holders selling strength, not fear; the honest hook is WHO takes profit and when.
items.checkable: Wallets whose balance fell below the 5k residency bar that day, split by exit vs entry price.
